func TestStructureReactComponentNoDisplayNamePort(t *testing.T) {
    t.Parallel()
    oracle := goOracle(t)
    directory := mutant(t, "", "")
    var rows []string
    count := 0
    for _, row := range upstream(t) {
        fields := strings.Split(row, "\t")
        if len(fields)>1 && fields[1]=="structure/react-component-no-display-name" { rows=append(rows,row); count++ }
    }
    if count != 56 { t.Fatalf("captured upstream case count: got %d, want 56", count) }
    t.Logf("structure-react-component-no-display-name upstream cases: %d",count)
    for _, d := range prepareRegistry(t,".") {
        if d.Name == "structure/react-component-no-display-name" {
            for _, row := range ownedWitnessRows(t,".",d) {
                result := execute(t,"",oracle,"--manifest",manifest(t,[]string{row}),"--count")
                if string(result.output) == "0\n" { t.Fatal("witness has no Go finding",row) }
                rows=append(rows,row)
                rows=append(rows,strings.SplitN(row,"\t",2)[0]+"\tall")
            }
        }
    }
    for _, row := range generated(t) {
        fields := strings.Split(row,"\t")
        if len(fields)==1 || fields[1]=="all" || fields[1]=="structure/react-component-no-display-name" { rows=append(rows,row) }
    }
    compare(t,oracle,buildPort(t,directory,true),directory,manifest(t,rows))
}
